[attribute-vol]
=== `@vol` Volume of Related Article

Volume of the journal in which a related journal article exists.

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<attribute-vol,`@vol`>> attribute can be used, along with the <<attribute-journal-id,`@journal-id`>>, <<attribute-issue,`@issue`>>, and <<attribute-page,`@page`>> attributes, to provide the metadata for a related journal article.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The journal volume number for a related journal article, for example,
                        “`3`” for the third volume,
                        “`125`” for the one hundred and twenty-fifth, or
                        “`XV`” for the fifteenth.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
